result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the bottom navigation area has a clear visual defect: a stray dark horizontal bar overlaps the search icon, and the nav bar itself appears partially clipped.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, a search icon is overlapped by a long dark horizontal bar (likely a stray input/divider element) that extends across the middle of the screen and crosses the search icon.
issues.suggestion: Remove the stray horizontal bar or ensure the bottom nav items are laid out properly with adequate spacing so the search icon is fully visible.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar appears clipped, showing only the icons without labels and with the home icon partially cut off at the bottom edge.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the bottom nav padding/height so the icons and labels fit fully within the viewport.
